## 📏 New: Ribbon size

Is the toolbar at the bottom of the board (Pen, Eraser, Select, Undo, pages, zoom …) too big for your display, or too small? You can now resize it.

- Open **More → Settings → Ribbon size** and drag the slider. It goes from **60 %** (slim) to **150 %** (big).
- The ribbon changes **as you drag**, so you can pick the right size on the board itself. The Settings menu stays open.
- **Only the ribbon changes.** Menus and panels keep their size.
- **Normal ribbon size** goes back to 100 %.
- The size is **remembered** after a restart, and also when you change **Interface size**. Interface size still makes the ribbon and the menus bigger or smaller together.
- On a big ribbon, if it is too wide for the screen, Fit, the zoom buttons and File / Insert / Edit hide first. Everything is still in **More**.

## Also included

Everything from v0.3.0: the **Calculator** (More → Calculator, with Put on board), the PDF user guide in the Start menu, 10-point multi-touch, zoom and pan with two fingers, and erasing part of a shape.

## Install

1. Download **ClassBoard-Setup-0.3.1-x64.exe** below and run it.
2. If Windows shows *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway**. The installer is not digitally signed.
3. Already have ClassBoard? Run the new installer over it: your lessons and settings are kept.

Works on Windows 10 / 11, fully offline.
